taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You tapped "Little support". What is happening?
My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so my Teams messages about billing disputes wait until the next morning. Yesterday a customer credit note ended up waiting two days for review.
What would help you process the credit notes while your team lead is on calls?
Having a backup person I can ask, or a fixed 15-minute slot each day with my lead, would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire experiences delays on billing disputes because the team lead is unavailable during the day. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so my Teams messages about billing disputes wait until the next morning."
